name: HEIR FANATIC

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Heir Fanatic
Most members of the Heirs count as fanatics. These people
burn with patriotic indignation and believe that they will,
like their ancestors before them, throw off the chains of
tyranny and remake their land into something greater than
it ever was. Without manipulation, these people would be
ordinary folk, engaged in any occupation and with their
whole lives before them. Falling under the leader’s spell has
uprooted them from their lives to take up arms for this holy
cause.

HEIR FANATIC

DIFFICULTY 1

Size 1 human
Perception 9 (-1)
Defense 12 (hard leather); Health 11; Insanity 1d3 - 1;
Corruption 0
Strength 11 (+1), Agility 10 (+0), Intellect 9 (-1), Will 9 (-1)
Speed 10
Strength in Numbers When within short range of 5 or more
creatures friendly to them, an heir fanatic makes attack
rolls and challenge rolls with 1 boon.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Club (melee) +1 (1d6)

name: WYVERN CLAW

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Wyvern Claw
Selected from the most capable and violent members of
the fanatics, the wyvern claws comprise a force of obedient
killers who show no hesitation when called to use force
to deal with the cult’s enemies. Wyvern claws form elite
squads sent to carry out dangerous, even suicidal missions,
but, when not sent out to kill, they protect the cult’s elite
members. Wyvern claws wear the same uniforms worn by
the fanatics except for the bronze wyverns pinned to their
lapels.

WYVERN CLAW

DIFFICULTY 5

Size 1 human
Perception 9 (-1)
Defense 13 (hard leather); Health 21; Insanity 1d3;
Corruption 1
Strength 12 (+2), Agility 11 (+1), Intellect 9 (-1), Will 11 (+1)
Speed 10
Strength of Conviction A wyvern claw imposes 1 bane on
attack rolls against their Intellect and Will. In addition,
whenever they become charmed, compelled, dazed, or
frightened, make a Will challenge roll. On a success, the
affliction ends.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Flail (melee) +2 with 1 boon (2d6 + 2)

6

name: WYVERN EYES

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Wyvern Eyes
As the membership swells and the Heirs’ popularity grows,
both Dolof Mylen and Cardinal Allora fear enemies might
infiltrate their ranks. It would be nice to think that everyone
who joined shared the same enthusiasm and dedication to
the cause, but the leaders know that the Cult of the New
God has spies everywhere and, worse, the sitting godqueen opposes their presence in Old Edene. To root out
the disloyal members and secret apologists for the New
God, the Heirs formed the Wyvern Eyes to serve as a spy
network.
Eyes have tattooed in the palm of their hands a green eye
with a slitted pupil, which they show to identify themselves
when needed. Most disguise themselves in ordinary
clothing so they can get close to hidden enemies and
discover their secrets. People they find dangerous to the
Heirs’ cause disappear, never to be seen again.

WYVERN EYES

DIFFICULTY 5

Size 1 human
Perception 11 (+1)
Defense 13 (soft leather); Health 21; Insanity 1d3;
Corruption 1d3
Strength 11 (+1), Agility 12 (+2), Intellect 11 (+1), Will 10 (+0)
Speed 10
Fast on their Feet When a wyvern eye deals damage to a
creature, the eye’s movement triggers no free attacks until
the start of their next turn.

ATTACK OPTIONS
Long Knife (melee) +2 with 1 boon (1d6 plus Wicked Slash on
attack roll 20+)
Wicked Slash A flesh-and-blood target becomes impaired for
1 minute. While impaired in this way, the target takes 1d6
extra damage each time it takes damage.
